title: [Peppol] Fix Remittance Advice XML line count, Note order and invoice reference
summary: The Peppol remittance advice XML export now correctly reports the actual line count, orders note elements according to XSD requirements, and uses the vendor invoice number for invoice references.
key_points: LineCountNumeric element now reflects the actual number of lines instead of always showing zero
Line-level Note elements are positioned immediately after ID elements to match XSD schema requirements
Invoice references now prioritize the vendor's external document number, falling back to the system document number
InvoicingPartyReference element is no longer emitted from the export
New test validates all three corrections
